content.title: Noem slams question about her relationship with Lewandowski as ‘tabloid garbage’
content.text: Noem, whose husband, Bryon, attended the hearing, reacted with noticeable anger in her voice. “I am shocked we’re peddling tabloid garbage in this committee,” she responded.Noem also said Lewandowski is a “special government employee who works for the White House. There are thousands of them in the federal government,” adding that he has no influence over decisions at DHS.Kamlager-Dove pressed for an answer, saying “it is okay for you to be offended by the question. But it is also a real question and you should be able to answer the question clearly and without hesitation … you should be wanting to answer that question.”In earlier appearances before the Senate, no lawmakers have asked Noem directly about her relationship with Lewandowski.The next Democrat to ask questions after Kamlager-Dove, Jared Moskowitz of Florida, pressed her further.“I really think you need to say the word ‘no’ into the record so that you can clear that up,” Moskowitz said.Noem, even more incensed, lashed Moskowitz as a part of the “liberal media.”“You say conservative women are stupid or sluts. I am neither,” she fired back.Previous news reports alleged that the two have engaged in a romantic relationship, though both denied the claims.Before her exchange with Kamlager-Dove and Moskowitz, Noem had largely avoided fireworks in the House Judiciary hearing, as Republicans offered her political cover and Democrats pressed her about her leadership of DHS, including the killings of two U.S. citizens in Minneapolis by federal agents.
